article.headline: Zion Stanford posts double-double to guide Towson to 66-46 victory over Long Island University
article.description: — Zion Stanford totaled 12 points and 10 rebounds to lead Towson to a 66-46 victory over Long Island University on Monday night.
article.linkText: Zion Stanford posts double-double to guide Towson to 66-46 victory over Long Island University

keywords: Long Island University Sharks @ Towson Tigers
article.story: TOWSON, Md. -- — Zion Stanford totaled 12 points and 10 rebounds to lead Towson to a 66-46 victory over Long Island University on Monday night. Stanford added three steals for the Tigers (1-2). Jaquan Womack and Ben Roseborough also scored 12 points. Daquan Davis led the way for the Sharks (0-4) with 19 points. LIU also got six points, 10 rebounds and three blocks from Ryan Bewley. Towson took the lead with 14:41 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Womack had 10 points by halftime for a 38-28 lead. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
